memos.headline: Can't verify what drives an $0.85 FFO raise; release unreachable, no 8-K yet, and the numbers point to one-offs
reasoning: Primary source: SL Green's release on GlobeNewswire (16:42 ET per Benzinga 20:42 UTC). GlobeNewswire refused our request (HTTP 403) and no 8-K is on EDGAR yet, so we have only Benzinga's summaries. Drivers of the raise: UNCONFIRMED.

Quoted headlines: 'SL Green Realty Raises FY2026 FFO Guidance from $5.60-$5.90 to $6.50-$6.70 vs $5.32 Est'; 'SL Green Realty Q3 FFO $1.59 Beats $1.47 Estimate, Sales $165.552M Miss $176.394M Estimate'.

The arithmetic says the raise is not mostly recurring business: the guide rose $0.85 at the midpoint while Q3 beat by only $0.12, so most of the raise must come from items in Q4 or already booked that the old guide excluded. Consensus at $5.32 sits below even the old guide, which means analysts already exclude items management counts in FFO (for an office REIT, often gains on debt extinguishment or one-time fees).
Revenue missed ($165.6M vs $176.4M estimate, per Benzinga).
Price: no IEX after-hours trades; the release came after the 16:00 close and IEX's session ends at 17:00.
objections: Primary source unreachable; the driver of a $0.85 FFO raise against a $0.12 beat is unverified and likely non-recurring.

objections: Primary source unreachable; the driver of a $0.85 FFO raise against a $0.12 beat is unverified and likely non-recurring.

memos.headline: Small raise: EPS guide +$0.11 at the midpoint, sales guide unchanged; buyback is an authorization, not spending
reasoning: Source: Wyndham's Q3 release (Benzinga 20:33 UTC, 16:33 ET): 'Wyndham Hotels & Resorts Raises FY2026 Adj EPS Guidance from $4.71-$4.83 to $4.84-$4.92 vs $4.80 Est; Affirms FY2026 Sales Guidance of $1.480B-$1.500B vs $1.481B Est'.

Quoted summary: 'a 6% year-over-year increase in U.S. RevPAR for the third quarter'; 'the board of directors authorized an increase of $400 million to the company's share repurchase program'; '$100 million in free cash flow for the quarter'.

What changed: EPS midpoint $4.88 from $4.77 (+2.3%), 1.7% above consensus; sales outlook unchanged. The $400M is permission to buy back, about 7% of the $5.8B market value, spread over years, not an announced purchase.
Price: no IEX after-hours trades. WH rose 1.3% in the session before the release.
objections: Incremental: a 2% EPS raise on unchanged sales guidance; the buyback is an authorization.

memos.headline: Raise only to consensus: adj EPS guide midpoint $33.63 vs $33.64 estimate
reasoning: Primary source: CACI's release on PR Newswire (Benzinga 20:19 UTC, 16:19 ET): 'CACI International Raises FY2027 Adj EPS Guidance from $32.96-$33.86 to $33.18-$34.08 vs $33.64 Est; Raises FY2027 Sales Guidance from $10.650B-$10.850B to $10.700B-$10.900B vs $10.808B Est'.
Quoted summary: revenue '$2.5 billion ... an 8.2% increase'; 'adjusted diluted EPS rising 11.8% to $7.66'; '$4.8 billion in contract awards and a 2.0x book-to-bill ratio'.

What changed: the guidance moved up to where analysts already were; the adj EPS midpoint ($33.63) equals consensus ($33.64), sales midpoint $10.80B vs $10.808B. Strong awards, but nothing the estimates did not already carry.
Price: no IEX after-hours trades; CACI rose 2.1% in the session.
objections: The raise lands on consensus; no surprise to price.
